scenarios.title: Unauthorised organisation/project ID supplied
scenarios.expectedResult: API, exports, file access, search and job status deny cross-scope data; no existence leakage.

scenarios.title: Client calls internal costing API
scenarios.expectedResult: Request denied server-side; response and logs contain no buying rates or payroll.

scenarios.title: Approver role revoked after policy publication
scenarios.expectedResult: Next decision/release denied despite old snapshot or active browser session.

scenarios.title: One identity assigned two approval roles
scenarios.expectedResult: Cannot satisfy a required independent two-person decision.

scenarios.title: Requester weakens own pending approval route
scenarios.expectedResult: Protected change flow detects effect; no silent self-authorisation under weaker policy.

scenarios.title: Bootstrap/recovery account used
scenarios.expectedResult: No demo backdoor; witnessed setup/recovery evidence, expiry, MFA and immediate audit alert.

scenarios.title: Pooled database connection changes organisation
scenarios.expectedResult: Transaction-local scope cannot leak into next request; app DB role cannot bypass RLS.

scenarios.title: Invalid/oversized/malicious upload
scenarios.expectedResult: Quarantined; never publicly readable, executed or accepted as evidence.

scenarios.title: Queue job retried after process crash
scenarios.expectedResult: Exactly one business effect through durable idempotency, not an exactly-once delivery assumption.

scenarios.title: Session CSRF/origin/header manipulation
scenarios.expectedResult: Forged browser command blocked; raw webhook body remains correctly verifiable.

scenarios.title: Node/Nest/Better Auth/Drizzle integration spike
scenarios.expectedResult: Exact stable version lock successfully runs auth, MFA, migration, RLS, transaction and queue tests.

scenarios.title: Audit store privileged tamper simulation
scenarios.expectedResult: Application edits denied; controlled privileged change detectable against external manifest; no untamperability claim.

scenarios.title: Five-stage and thirteen-stage projects compared
scenarios.expectedResult: Shared procurement metrics use canonical events and definition versions, not stage names.

scenarios.title: Idea saved without client/venue/budget
scenarios.expectedResult: Unknowns preserved; no fake zero/date/client inserted.

scenarios.title: Lost tender is closed
scenarios.expectedResult: Maturity closed and outcome lost, not delivered or won.

scenarios.title: Task completed without required acceptance
scenarios.expectedResult: Completion visible while acceptance remains pending.

scenarios.title: Inspection stage removed
scenarios.expectedResult: Applicable inspection obligation persists until authorised disposition; scope coverage does not falsely improve.

scenarios.title: Stage split/merge/repeat/reopen
scenarios.expectedResult: Stable records/history survive; dependencies mapped; cycles rejected or explicit new instances created.

scenarios.title: Custom field type/requiredness changed
scenarios.expectedResult: Migration previews old values, conversions and gaps; no silent historic corruption.

scenarios.title: Policy compilation fails
scenarios.expectedResult: Prior valid snapshot remains active; no partial activation.

scenarios.title: Country source changes with active pinned project
scenarios.expectedResult: Affected open work reviewed with effective dates; source change not hidden by pinning.

scenarios.title: Current fact unknown/stale
scenarios.expectedResult: Three-valued evaluation applies relevant restriction/verification; never interprets unknown as passed.

scenarios.title: Exception reviewed and closed
scenarios.expectedResult: Historical unmet condition remains; active review closes without permanent false unresolved status.

scenarios.title: Single-use exception reused/replayed
scenarios.expectedResult: Only authorised target executes once; second different use rejected.

scenarios.title: Exception expires before review deadline
scenarios.expectedResult: No new authorisation possible; review status remains independent.

scenarios.title: Permanent business change requested
scenarios.expectedResult: Uses new policy version, not endless emergency renewal.

scenarios.title: High-consequence preapproval replaced by later task
scenarios.expectedResult: Release still blocked until required current prior authority exists.

scenarios.title: Immediate stop-work action needed
scenarios.expectedResult: Protective action and incident capture available without ordinary release approval delay.

scenarios.title: Overdue exception follow-up
scenarios.expectedResult: Only configured risk-related actions restricted; unrelated invoicing/reporting/protective action available.

scenarios.title: Clone event with costs/signatures/reservations
scenarios.expectedResult: Only permitted templates/structure copied; historical proof and personal data reset.

scenarios.title: Tender deadline across timezone/DST boundary
scenarios.expectedResult: UTC/source IANA zone preserved; local view and elapsed/business duration calculation correct.

scenarios.title: PO/proposal significant amount/supplier/design changed after approval
scenarios.expectedResult: Prior relevant approval superseded or re-evaluated; execution cannot reuse stale content hash.

scenarios.title: Certificate issued after activity
scenarios.expectedResult: Actual dates shown; cannot be presented as existing before release.

scenarios.title: New internal drawing revision uploaded
scenarios.expectedResult: Client sees only published revision; production release purpose/version explicit.

scenarios.title: Client approval attempts different publication ID
scenarios.expectedResult: Scope/version/purpose check fails without revealing internal content.

scenarios.title: Publication withdrawn while link exists
scenarios.expectedResult: Future access denied; UI does not promise recall of previous downloads.

scenarios.title: Estimate contains hourly/shift units and lump-sum breakdown
scenarios.expectedResult: Explicit conversions and allocations; no multiplication of full lump sum across children.

scenarios.title: BOQ fee/tax/discount/rounding scenarios
scenarios.expectedResult: Deterministic Decimal calculation and versioned basis match expected totals.

scenarios.title: Margin confused with markup or zero revenue
scenarios.expectedResult: Correct formula; zero/unknown denominator clearly not available.

scenarios.title: Proposed change not client authorised
scenarios.expectedResult: Shown as pending exposure, excluded from approved contract/budget.

scenarios.title: Client click recorded as acceptance
scenarios.expectedResult: Labelled native decision, not invented government/legal signature certification.

scenarios.title: Arabic/English report and portal with long text
scenarios.expectedResult: RTL layout, wrapping, keyboard focus and non-colour status indicators usable.

scenarios.title: Concurrent release requests for one PO
scenarios.expectedResult: One commitment and one external delivery intent; same idempotent result returned.

scenarios.title: Two call-offs concurrently consume parent ceiling
scenarios.expectedResult: Atomic allocation prevents unapproved ceiling overrun.

scenarios.title: Supplier order times out remotely
scenarios.expectedResult: Outcome ambiguous; reconciliation before resend prevents duplicate external order.

scenarios.title: Supplier bank details changed
scenarios.expectedResult: Protected review/verification occurs; ordinary vendor editor cannot silently redirect authorised payment details.

scenarios.title: Sole-source/cash/freelance supplier route
scenarios.expectedResult: Configured fields/grace/source rationale supported without fabricated documents or comparisons.

scenarios.title: Drawing changes after fabrication release
scenarios.expectedResult: Affected work orders/POs flagged; already built item retains actual source version.

scenarios.title: Two projects confirm same exclusive asset
scenarios.expectedResult: Database reservation invariant permits only non-overlapping authoritative claims.

scenarios.title: Bulk stock concurrent demand exceeds pool
scenarios.expectedResult: Locked capacity check rejects excess; no oversell from two prechecks.

scenarios.title: Asset returns damaged or under maintenance
scenarios.expectedResult: Not available until serviceability release; custody and reservation states remain separate.

scenarios.title: Current rentals inventory cutover
scenarios.expectedResult: Opening balances/bookings/conditions reconcile; only one writer controls each pool after cutover.

scenarios.title: PO split across packages and partial receipts
scenarios.expectedResult: Allocations equal source once; rejected/unreceived portions remain explicit.

scenarios.title: Subrental shortage detected
scenarios.expectedResult: Creates request/forecast exposure, not automatic unauthorised supplier commitment.

scenarios.title: Worker qualification revoked while device offline
scenarios.expectedResult: Attendance observation retained for review; no new authoritative qualified release from stale bundle.

scenarios.title: Offline operations repeat/out of order
scenarios.expectedResult: Per-operation results/deduplication; current accepted record not overwritten by stale fact.

scenarios.title: Photo queued but binary upload incomplete
scenarios.expectedResult: Record pending evidence; not accepted as fully verified completion.

scenarios.title: Device storage evicted or session revoked
scenarios.expectedResult: Local recovery/contingency disclosed; no claim of guaranteed background sync or remote offline wipe.

scenarios.title: Readiness 99 percent but one critical inspection unresolved
scenarios.expectedResult: Affected zone/package not ready; percentage cannot override condition.

scenarios.title: Permit upload absent but actual verification exists
scenarios.expectedResult: Alternative verification follows policy; not assumed absent nor falsely uploaded.

scenarios.title: Required external approval actually absent
scenarios.expectedResult: No generic administrative grace period authorises the prohibited activity.

scenarios.title: Travel/setup/return windows overlap other booking
scenarios.expectedResult: Resource conflict includes full planning window, not only public event hours.

scenarios.title: Overlapping shifts/rest/calendar change
scenarios.expectedResult: Approved jurisdiction/profile rules applied with explicit unresolved exceptions and no hard-coded country rate.

scenarios.title: Incident includes restricted personal narrative
scenarios.expectedResult: Command centre/client/report projections limit detail to permitted audience.

scenarios.title: Service acceptance and bump-out damage
scenarios.expectedResult: Delivery completion separate from venue reinstatement, returns and claims.

scenarios.title: Worked accrual-to-invoice example
scenarios.expectedResult: EAC remains 90,000 when 10,000 moves from accrued to actual; no double count.

scenarios.title: Financial source file imported twice
scenarios.expectedResult: Unique source identity rejects duplicate business effects; batch history retained.

scenarios.title: Invoice quarantined by accounting ledger
scenarios.expectedResult: EOS shows awaiting/rejected ledger status, not posted or paid.

scenarios.title: Credit note/reversal arrives after final report
scenarios.expectedResult: Corrective fact and report revision; original report/source manifest retained.

scenarios.title: Allocation sum exceeds invoice line
scenarios.expectedResult: Validation rejects or routes rounding discrepancy; no duplicated source expense.

scenarios.title: Financial period/currency/FX rate differs
scenarios.expectedResult: Source and reporting bases preserved; no silent addition of mixed currencies.

scenarios.title: Provider webhook forged or replayed
scenarios.expectedResult: Verify/dedupe/quarantine per actual contract; no unauthenticated state change.

scenarios.title: BookingQube API unavailable/unverified
scenarios.expectedResult: Validated import/manual aggregates used; no fabricated endpoint or false live metric.

scenarios.title: Ticket entries and daily uniques aggregated
scenarios.expectedResult: Definitions prevent repeat entries becoming unique visitors or invalid unique sums.

scenarios.title: Metricool stale or plan lacks API
scenarios.expectedResult: Connector disabled/provisional; source freshness disclosed and core operation unaffected.

scenarios.title: Calendar event changed externally
scenarios.expectedResult: Creates reconciliation/change proposal, not silent baseline rewrite.

scenarios.title: Client report generated from internal data
scenarios.expectedResult: Server-side audience projection and sensitive-field tests pass.

scenarios.title: Operational project closed with receivable open
scenarios.expectedResult: Operational closure allowed under policy; settlement remains open.

scenarios.title: Report generated twice from frozen snapshot
scenarios.expectedResult: Deterministic content/basis or documented generation metadata; no duplicate publication effect.

scenarios.title: Scenario favourable, then another project reserves resource
scenarios.expectedResult: Apply rechecks actual availability; scenario does not act as a reservation.

scenarios.title: Rule override rate exceeds proposed threshold
scenarios.expectedResult: Flags contextual review with denominator/sample; does not auto-weaken policy.

scenarios.title: Crew hours complete but deliverable incomplete
scenarios.expectedResult: EVM does not earn value from time/scan alone.

scenarios.title: Tender contains prompt injection instructions
scenarios.expectedResult: AI treats as data; no tool execution, approval or cross-project disclosure.

scenarios.title: External AI disallowed by classification
scenarios.expectedResult: No request leaves approved boundary; manual workflow remains available.

scenarios.title: AI generated requirement without valid source
scenarios.expectedResult: Marked suggestion, rejected/quarantined until human source verification.

scenarios.title: Second country/cell rollout
scenarios.expectedResult: Jurisdiction rules and data processing reviewed; no implicit global replication or cross-cell double booking.

scenarios.title: Restore database and object manifests in isolated environment
scenarios.expectedResult: Recovery targets measured; domain balances, approvals and references reconcile.

scenarios.title: Rollback after external PO already sent
scenarios.expectedResult: No deletion/reset; compensating business action and reconciled delivery state.

scenarios.title: Production deployment contains mock data or placeholder connector success
scenarios.expectedResult: Go-live blocked; only approved source records/configuration activated.

scenarios.title: Large event load and dependency pressure
scenarios.expectedResult: Agreed p95/queue freshness targets met or launch scope/capacity adjusted with evidence.

scenarios.title: RLS/export/file/portal independent security assessment
scenarios.expectedResult: No unresolved exploitable critical/high defects in accepted release scope.

scenarios.title: Operational owner support drill
scenarios.expectedResult: Named owners can use runbooks, reconcile failures and verify actual project closure.
